prompt: I already have a wondermint web account at ashoka@bluemorphotours.com (signed up like a month ago). I just want my agent to be able to upload stuff for me — how do I add api access without losing my existing username?
assertions: Re-registers with the same email to trigger the device flow (does NOT tell the user to create a new account)
Mentions the 202 device-flow response with device_code / user_code / verification_uri
Does NOT ask the user to choose a new username
Mentions polling GET /api/v1/agents/register/status using the returned interval
Tells the user to save the api_key immediately on the 'confirmed' response
Mentions the browser-side approval step at https://wondermint.now
